title: Dashboard render timeout
root_cause: Widget query exceeded the 60 second render budget
workaround: Reduce widget count or enable result caching on the underlying dataset

title: Cross-filter loop detected
root_cause: Two widgets reference each other as filter sources
workaround: Remove one direction of the cross-filter relationship

title: PDF export failed: asset too large
symptom: Users encounter ERR-1210 (pdf export failed: asset too large).
root_cause: Rendered dashboard exceeds the 50 MB export ceiling
workaround: Export tabs individually or lower image DPI in export settings

title: Connector handshake failed
root_cause: TLS negotiation failed because the warehouse requires TLS 1.3
workaround: Enable TLS 1.3 in the connector advanced settings, available in 5.0 and later

title: OAuth token refresh rejected
symptom: Users encounter ERR-2231 (oauth token refresh rejected).
root_cause: Refresh token expired after the identity provider rotated signing keys
workaround: Reauthorize the connection from the connector settings page

title: Schema discovery timed out
symptom: Users encounter ERR-2288 (schema discovery timed out).
root_cause: Warehouse information_schema query exceeded 120 seconds on very large catalogs
workaround: Scope the connection to specific schemas instead of the full catalog

title: Dataset refresh deadlock
root_cause: Concurrent incremental refresh and full refresh acquired locks in opposite order
workaround: Stagger refresh schedules or disable overlapping refresh in dataset settings

title: Row-level security rule not applied
symptom: Users encounter ERR-3340 (row-level security rule not applied).
root_cause: RLS rules referencing calculated fields are evaluated after aggregation
workaround: Rewrite the RLS rule against a raw column, not a calculated field

title: Alert delivery throttled
root_cause: More than 100 alert emails to a single recipient within one hour
workaround: Consolidate alerts with report bursting or raise the throttle limit per workspace

title: Webhook signature mismatch
root_cause: Receiving endpoint validated against a rotated webhook secret
workaround: Update the shared secret on the receiver; secrets rotate every 90 days by default

title: Query timeout in SQL Workbench
symptom: Users encounter ERR-5501 (query timeout in sql workbench).
root_cause: Interactive queries are capped at 300 seconds on standard tier
workaround: Move long-running queries to a scheduled dataset refresh or upgrade tier limits

title: API rate limit exceeded
symptom: Users encounter ERR-6601 (api rate limit exceeded).
root_cause: More than 600 requests per minute per service account
workaround: Batch requests, add exponential backoff, or request a limit increase

title: Signed embed URL expired
symptom: Users encounter ERR-6640 (signed embed url expired).
root_cause: Embed URLs are valid for 10 minutes; the host page cached one longer
workaround: Generate embed URLs server side per page load, never cache them

title: SAML assertion rejected
root_cause: Clock skew between the identity provider and the platform exceeded 5 minutes
workaround: Sync IdP server clocks with NTP; skew tolerance is configurable in 5.1

title: SCIM provisioning conflict
root_cause: A SCIM push tried to create a user whose email already exists as a local account
workaround: Convert the local account to SSO before enabling SCIM for that domain
